description: Fetch a photo from the Holiday Photo Plus library and display it inline in the chat. `name` is the filename of the photo as it lives in the repo's `public/holidayphotos/` folder (e.g. 'Photo1.png'). A substring also matches. Omit `name` to get a random photo.

name.description: Photo pathname, filename, or substring. Omit for a random photo.

name: get_photo
